mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_department (dept_id, tenant_id, name, parent_dept_id, org_id, manager_id, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{deptId}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{parentDeptId}, #{orgId}, #{managerId}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT dept_id, tenant_id, name, parent_dept_id, org_id, manager_id, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT dept_id, tenant_id, name, parent_dept_id, org_id, manager_id, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY created_at
